The aggregator.rs withdraw RPC forwards user withdrawal requests containing an outpoint/UTXO to operators, whose withdraw() processes its script_pubkey.

impact.affected_asset: Availability of Clementine operator, verifier, and bridge services.
impact.attacker_capability: Any user can submit a non-P2TR address or qualifying withdrawal UTXO input that reaches an affected fixed-offset script_pubkey extraction; the report states the deposit-validation case can use a transaction absent from chain and mempool.
impact.security_effect: Temporary denial of service against bridge operators, verifiers, and potentially bridge operations through remotely induced panics.

causal_trace.summary: A user supplies a non-P2TR recovery address or a withdrawal-associated UTXO whose script_pubkey is shorter than the assumed Taproot encoding; the report gives P2WPKH as an example.
Affected paths assume that supplied address or UTXO script_pubkey values are P2TR and therefore have the required prefix and at least 34 bytes, without validating that layout before key extraction.
generate_deposit_address(), get_deposit_scripts(), and operator withdraw() extract an x-only key with script_pubkey.as_bytes()[2..34]; evaluating that range on a shorter script panics out of bounds.

The reported panic can crash operators or verifiers. Restarted nodes may crash again when reprocessing the malicious deposit or withdrawal, temporarily halting bridge operations until a fix is deployed.

failure.operation: Rust bounds-checked slice evaluation of script_pubkey.as_bytes()[2..34], followed by attempted x-only public-key parsing

primary_invariant.kind: validated Bitcoin scriptPubKey layout before fixed-offset extraction
primary_invariant.statement: A 32-byte x-only public key may be sliced at byte range [2..34] only after the script_pubkey has been validated as a P2TR output with the required prefix and length.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The affected functions treat user-provided addresses or UTXOs as P2TR and apply [2..34] directly; a shorter non-P2TR script_pubkey violates the required range precondition.

quality.review_notes: The primary audit report supplies affected functions, code excerpts, trigger class, failure operation, impact, recommendations, and reported resolution commit. No upstream source diff, regression test, or observed execution artifact is in this bundle; the process-crash oracle is report-grounded rather than independently reproduced.

remediation.invariant_restored: The [2..34] extraction is reached only for a script_pubkey validated as a P2TR output, so its expected prefix and key-bearing length are established before slicing.
mitigation_classes: validate P2TR script_pubkey type and layout before extraction
validate recovery Taproot address at deposit/withdrawal flow conversion boundaries
enforce minimum length before extracting the last 20 bytes of a block hash

oracle.expected_negative: A P2TR-valid script_pubkey reaches extraction without a bounds panic; a non-P2TR script is rejected before fixed-offset extraction after remediation.
oracle.expected_positive: An affected pre-resolution flow processing a shorter non-P2TR script_pubkey reaches the [2..34] slice and panics.
